title: Air Arabia flight from Abu Dhabi lands safely in Thiruvananthapuram after suspected bird strike
summary: Despite the suspected bird hit, the crew continued the flight in accordance with standard safety procedures. The aircraft completed its journey without incident and landed safely in Thiruvananthapuram in Kerala

title: Kerala’s Thekkady faces bleak tourist season as Periyar Lake’s water level plummets
summary: Forest department and Kerala Tourism Development Corporation reduce the seating capacity in their boating services, rendering tickets scarce for tourists, who mainly come to Thekkady to enjoy boating and watch wildlife. Drinking water projects in the Kumily and Chakkupallom panchayats too affected by the falling water level

title: Mohan Bhagwat bats for wider promotion of Sanskrit
summary: The RSS chief says a significant proportion of vocabulary across linguistic traditions in India was either derived from or influenced by Sanskrit. Its growth will not displace but rather strengthen other languages, he says

title: Kerala Police warn of fake update scam targeting smarphone users
summary: Kerala Police have warned of a cyber fraud targeting users of Vivo and iQOO smartphones through fake "OriginOS Update" messages that trick users into installing malware and stealing sensitive data, including banking credentials
